metadata.title: SFTC Football/Soccer Teaching And Planning Database
metadata.description: App-facing football/soccer teaching, role, tactical, S&C, injury, macro-planning, and retrieval records derived from structured football research drafts.

sport_profiles.planning_summary: Football/soccer is an intermittent field sport combining repeated accelerations, high-speed running, deceleration, change of direction, duels, technical skill, tactical decision-making, and match-week fatigue management.
training_priorities: aerobic base and repeated sprint ability

advanced.high_speed_exposure: individualized by role and match load

common_injury_or_load_risks: Knee and ACL control risk rule
Ankle sprain and proprioception risk rule
Calf and Achilles tendon risk rule
Youth growth and maturation risk rule
Injury Risk Second Striker False Nine
do_not_pair: large novel sprint volume with heavy lower-body eccentric work in the same fatigue-limited window
heavy lower-body soreness work within 24 hours of important matches
heading/contact progression when concussion symptoms or head injury suspicion exists
new maximal sprint exposure late in a congested match week
progression_guardrails: build running tolerance before repeated sprint or high-speed volume
progress speed, COD, and gym eccentric load separately when symptoms or fatigue are present
use role demands to bias technical and physical work without eliminating broad football skill exposure
reduce novelty and soreness near match day
use pain, readiness, and completion trends before increasing high-speed or COD exposure

sport_roles.summary: Specialist who protects the goal, controls the penalty area, distributes to start attacks, supports build-up under pressure, and organizes defensive set pieces.

attacking: choose short, through, wide, target, or space-behind distribution
switch play with feet or throw when available
defensive: sweep behind the defensive line when appropriate
attacking_transition: release counterattack quickly when advantage exists
secure possession if team is stretched
defensive_transition: decide stay, sweep, or delay in 1v1
set_pieces: claim or punch within feasible range
